evals.name: start
evals.prompt: I want to learn networking by writing my own TCP/IP stack in C. Where do I start?
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds a first milestone (sockets echo or TAP device) with TODOs; no full stack; Mentions TUN/TAP (user-space packets) and that it requires Linux + root, or starts with Beej-style sockets

assertions.text: Routes correctly: reads the build-your-own-x router SKILL.md and the 'network-stack' track skill before answering
Scaffolds a first milestone (sockets echo or TAP device) with TODOs; no full stack
Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
Mentions TUN/TAP (user-space packets) and that it requires Linux + root, or starts with Beej-style sockets
Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
